name: ribbon-road-regional
about: A sound text-only ad: an empty road through wheat at sunrise, the words at the top. Redrawn for L5 (ADS-AD-LOOK-PLAN) in the new renderer's `ribbon` look (centred Anton headline, pill button, a hairline over the legal line): the same photo, words and kit as `clean-road-regional`, which is the same ad in the old overlay.

truth.how: nothing planted: the headline is about the road and the picture is the road

subject_legible.reason: A straight two-lane road running to a sunset between wheat fields reads instantly at phone size.

words_match_picture.reason: The headline about regional runs through farm country sits over an open road flanked by grain fields, telling one story.

hierarchy_reads.reason: The large white headline on dark sky leads and the white pill button follows, though the vivid orange sunset pulls some attention.

looks_like_kit.reason: White headline and a white button with navy lettering over a navy-toned sky match the brand colours; no logo was supplied or shown.
